cards.description: Mistral Large 4 是一个 1 万亿参数、原生多模态的混合专家模型，在网络安全基准上表现突出，其开放权重使安全团队能在自有基础设施上自主运行，避免提供商层面的拒绝阻碍合法研究。
cards.limitations: 以上信息来自 Hugging Face 的访谈视频简介，未提供独立的第三方复现或详细评测方法；模型在网络安全基准上的表现可能受评测条件影响，实际部署效果需进一步验证。
cards.summaryEn: Mistral Large 4 is an open-weight model from Mistral with 1 trillion total parameters, 52 billion active parameters, and native multimodality. It ranks among the top five on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index and solves 93% of Cybench challenges. The authors argue that open weights are crucial for defenders, enabling security teams to run the model on their own infrastructure under their own policies.
keyPointsEn: Mistral Large 4 uses a mixture-of-experts architecture with 1 trillion total parameters, 52 billion active parameters, and native multimodality.
It ranks among the top five on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index and solves 93% of Cybench challenges.
Open weights allow security teams to run the model on their own infrastructure, conducting vulnerability research and incident response under their own policies without provider-level refusals.
cards.descriptionEn: Mistral Large 4 is a 1-trillion-parameter, natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model with strong performance on cybersecurity benchmarks; its open weights allow security teams to run it on their own infrastructure, avoiding provider-level refusals that could block legitimate research.
cards.originalTitle: Science Behind the Open Cyber Frontier with Mistral Large 4
cards.titleEn: Mistral Large 4 Open-Weight Model: Cybersecurity Capabilities and the Significance of Openness
cards.limitationsEn: The information above comes from the Hugging Face interview video description; no independent third-party reproduction or detailed evaluation methodology is provided. The model's performance on cybersecurity benchmarks may depend on evaluation conditions, and real-world deployment effectiveness requires further verification.
keyPoints: Mistral Large 4 采用混合专家架构，总参数 1 万亿，激活参数 520 亿，原生多模态。
在 Artificial Analysis Cyber Index 中位列前五，Cybench 挑战解决率达 93%。
开放权重允许安全团队在自有基础设施上运行模型，按自身政策进行漏洞研究和事件响应，不受提供商层面拒绝的限制。
cards.summary: Mistral Large 4 是 Mistral 推出的开放权重模型，参数规模达 1 万亿，激活参数 520 亿，原生支持多模态。在 Artificial Analysis Cyber Index 中排名前五，并解决了 93% 的 Cybench 挑战。作者认为开放权重对防御者至关重要，可让安全团队在自有基础设施上按自身策略运行模型。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For security teams defending real software, open weights mean they can deploy advanced models in their own environments with control over policies and access, avoiding obstacles to legitimate cybersecurity work caused by provider refusals.
cards.title: Mistral Large 4 开放权重模型：网络安全能力与开放意义
cards.whyItMatters: 对防御真实软件的安全团队而言，开放权重意味着可以在自有环境中部署先进模型，自主控制策略和访问，避免因提供商拒绝而阻碍合法的网络安全工作。

cards.description: 该研究指出LLM服务动态批处理会导致同一请求因批次上下文不同而产生数值差异，现有内核生成智能体忽视批次不变性（BI）。提出的工具通过契约引导的静态依赖分析与动态比特一致性验证，作为插件增强通用内核智能体，在保持大部分加速比的同时提升BI通过率。
cards.limitations: 实验仅覆盖三类智能体框架和真实LLM服务任务，BI通过率与加速比的权衡结果基于特定基线；工具的动态验证依赖比特一致性检查，对非确定性或近似计算的容忍边界未在摘要中说明；静态分析可能无法覆盖所有结构风险，且未报告误判率与额外开销。
cards.summaryEn: The paper reports 19 confirmed BI violations among 83 batch-applicable kernel artifacts, meaning identical inputs yield different numerical outputs across batch contexts. The authors propose a plug-in tool integrating static dependency analysis and dynamic bitwise-consistency validation as acceptance gates in the kernel optimization loop. Experiments across three agent frameworks on real-world LLM serving tasks raise the BI pass rate from 67.6% to 91.9% while retaining 91.8% of the baseline geometric mean speedup.
keyPointsEn: 19 BI violations were confirmed among 83 batch-applicable released artifacts, indicating the issue is not rare in existing generated kernels.
The tool uses contract-guided static dependency analysis and dynamic bitwise-consistency validation, designed as a plug-in for general kernel agents to reuse their original optimization capabilities.
Across three agent frameworks on real-world LLM serving tasks, the BI pass rate improves from 67.6% to 91.9% while retaining 91.8% of the baseline geometric mean speedup.
cards.descriptionEn: This study identifies that dynamic batching in LLM serving can alter numerical outputs for identical requests when kernels lack batch invariance (BI), a property overlooked by existing kernel-generation agents. The proposed tool combines contract-guided static dependency analysis with dynamic bitwise-consistency validation as a plug-in for general kernel agents, improving BI pass rates while retaining most of the baseline speedup.
cards.originalTitle: God Does Not Play Dice: Enforcing Batch Invariance in Agentic Kernel Generation
cards.titleEn: Enforcing Batch Invariance in Agentic Kernel Generation
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments cover only three agent frameworks and real-world LLM serving tasks, and the BI-pass-rate versus speedup trade-off is tied to specific baselines. Dynamic validation relies on bitwise consistency checks, with tolerance boundaries for non-deterministic or approximate computations not specified in the abstract. Static analysis may not cover all structural risks, and false-positive rates and additional overhead are not reported.
keyPoints: 在83个可批处理的内核产物中确认了19个批次不变性违规，说明该问题在现有生成产物中并非罕见。
工具采用契约引导的静态依赖分析与动态比特一致性验证，作为插件接入通用内核智能体，复用其原有优化能力。
在三类智能体框架的真实LLM服务任务上，BI通过率从67.6%提升至91.9%，保留91.8%的基线几何平均加速比。
cards.summary: 论文发现，在83个可批处理的内核产物中有19个存在批次不变性违规，即相同输入在不同批次上下文中产生不同数值输出。作者提出一种结合静态依赖分析与动态比特一致性验证的插件工具，集成到内核优化循环中作为接受门控。实验表明，该工具将BI通过率从67.6%提升至91.9%，同时保留基线几何平均加速比的91.8%。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Lack of batch invariance undermines output reproducibility for identical requests in LLM serving. This work introduces BI as a reliability objective alongside correctness and speed in kernel generation, offering a pluggable engineering method to improve service determinism and result repeatability.
cards.title: 在智能体内核生成中强制批次不变性
cards.whyItMatters: 批次不变性缺失会破坏LLM服务中相同请求的输出可复现性，该工作将BI作为与正确性、速度并列的可靠性目标引入内核生成流程，为提升服务确定性和结果可重复性提供了可插拔的工程方法。

cards.description: 该研究通过大规模实验审计类型化决策模型中置信度承诺的可靠性，揭示点估计阈值选择常违背承诺而Learn then Test等方法能保持承诺，并分析了多语言校准、噪声鲁棒性及漂移场景下的表现。
cards.limitations: 研究仅对比了Laya和Jev两个模型，评估集中在190次可交换评估及有限领域；漂移场景下的结论基于预注册声明未获支持；探索性噪声训练结果需进一步验证；未涵盖所有可能的阈值选择方法。
cards.summaryEn: The paper measures what probability distributions returned by typed decision models license for decisions, finding that point-estimate thresholds break promises in 147 of 190 evaluations while Learn then Test keeps them in all. Calibrated API models keep a 95% promise in only 8 of 51 locales, and ordinary typing noise breaks promises calibrated on clean text. The authors argue that confidence licenses statements about groups of decisions, not guarantees for individual decisions.
keyPointsEn: Point-estimate thresholds break promises in 147/190 evaluations; Learn then Test keeps them in all.
Jev model keeps a 95% promise in only 8 of 51 locales; typing noise breaks calibrated promises.
Fine-tuned Laya needs 250 to 8,000 labels to be non-inferior to Jev in four domains, and does not reach it on LIAR2.
cards.descriptionEn: This study audits the reliability of confidence promises in typed decision models through large-scale experiments, revealing that point-estimate threshold selection often breaks promises while methods like Learn then Test keep them, and analyzes multilingual calibration, noise robustness, and drift scenarios.
cards.originalTitle: Confidence Is Not a Promise: A Reference Audit of Typed Decision Models
cards.titleEn: Confidence Audit of Typed Decision Models: Promises vs. Reality
cards.limitationsEn: The study compares only two models, Laya and Jev, with evaluations limited to 190 exchangeable evaluations and a few domains; drift conclusions are based on a preregistered claim not supported; exploratory noise training results need further validation; and not all possible threshold selection methods are covered.
keyPoints: 点估计阈值在147/190次评估中违背承诺，Learn then Test则全部保持。
Jev模型在51个地区中仅8个保持95%承诺，打字噪声会破坏校准承诺。
在四个额外领域中，微调Laya需250至8000个标签才能非劣于Jev，且在LIAR2上未达到。
cards.summary: 论文测量了类型化决策模型返回的概率分布对决策的许可程度，发现基于点估计的阈值在190次评估中有147次违背承诺，而Learn then Test方法全部保持承诺。校准后的API模型在多语言场景下承诺保持率低（51个地区中仅8个保持95%承诺），且普通打字噪声会破坏基于干净文本校准的承诺。作者观点认为置信度仅许可关于决策群体的陈述，而非单个决策的保证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The audit shows that confidence thresholds widely used in practice may frequently violate accuracy promises, while more rigorous methods like Learn then Test reliably keep them, highlighting risks for deploying models in high-stakes decision scenarios.
cards.title: 类型化决策模型的置信度审计：承诺与现实的差距
cards.whyItMatters: 该审计表明，实践中广泛使用的置信度阈值可能频繁违背准确性承诺，而更严谨的方法（如Learn then Test）能可靠保持承诺，这对高风险决策场景的模型部署具有警示意义。

cards.description: 该研究提出通用时序预训练框架 TimeHAT，用统一“点—片段”掩码监督同时覆盖细粒度波动与宏观模式，并以混合注意力编码器缓解秩退化，在分类、长期预测、插补和异常检测四类任务上评估。
cards.limitations: 输入仅提供摘要级信息，未给出各数据集规模、基线名单、指标数值与统计显著性，因此“具有竞争力”的具体幅度无法核实；秩退化缓解与掩码策略的各自贡献缺乏消融证据描述；少样本与零样本结论的适用数据域边界未说明。
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose TimeHAT, which unifies point-level and patch-level masking into a single pretraining objective combining contextual reconstruction and causal extrapolation. The method stacks prefix-constrained bidirectional attention in early layers with directional hybrid attention in deeper layers to retain contextual interaction while mitigating rank degeneration. Experiments span four downstream tasks under fine-tuning, few-shot, and zero-shot settings, with competitive performance reported as the authors' claim.
keyPointsEn: The Unified Point-Patch Masking Strategy (UPPMS) provides both point-level and patch-level supervision, capturing fine-grained variation and broader temporal patterns.
The Hybrid Attention Encoder (HAE) uses prefix-constrained bidirectional attention in initial layers and directional hybrid attention in deeper layers to mitigate rank degeneration.
Evaluation covers classification, long-term forecasting, imputation, and anomaly detection, including fine-tuning, few-shot, and zero-shot transfer settings.
cards.descriptionEn: The paper proposes TimeHAT, a general-purpose time-series pretraining framework whose unified point-patch masking supervision covers both fine-grained fluctuations and broader temporal patterns, and whose hybrid attention encoder aims to mitigate rank degeneration; it is evaluated on classification, long-term forecasting, imputation, and anomaly detection.
cards.originalTitle: Learning from Points and Patches: A Pre-trained Hybrid Attention Transformer for Time Series Analysis
cards.titleEn: TimeHAT: A Hybrid-Attention Pretraining Framework with Point-Patch Masking for Time Series
cards.limitationsEn: Only abstract-level information is available: dataset sizes, baseline lists, metric values, and significance tests are absent, so the magnitude of 'competitive' performance cannot be verified; no ablation evidence is described for the separate contributions of rank-degeneration mitigation and the masking strategy; the data-domain boundaries of the few-shot and zero-shot conclusions are unspecified.
keyPoints: 统一点—片段掩码策略（UPPMS）同时提供点级与片段级监督，兼顾细粒度变化与更宽的时间模式。
混合注意力编码器（HAE）在浅层用前缀约束双向注意力，深层转向方向性混合注意力，以缓解秩退化。
评估覆盖分类、长期预测、插补、异常检测四任务，并包含微调、少样本与零样本迁移设置。
cards.summary: 作者提出 TimeHAT，将点级与片段级掩码整合为统一预训练目标，兼顾上下文重建与因果外推。方法上用前缀约束的双向注意力叠加深层方向性混合注意力，意图保留上下文交互并缓解秩退化。实验覆盖四类下游任务及微调、少样本、零样本设置，报告具有竞争力表现，属作者自述结论。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Heterogeneous time series suffer from diverse patterns, variable lengths, and scarce high-quality labels; framing pretraining as separate 'what to learn' and 'how to learn' questions offers a reusable structural template for transferable time-series representations, and the public code supports replication and comparison.
cards.title: TimeHAT：点与片段混合掩码的时序预训练框架
cards.whyItMatters: 异构时序数据普遍存在模式多样、长度不一和高质量标注稀缺的问题，该工作把预训练“学什么”和“怎么学”拆解为可设计的两层，为构建可迁移时序表示提供了一种可复用的结构思路，其代码公开也便于后续复现与比较。

cards.description: 该研究提出Matching-LLM，将LLM生成的合成回答与历史人类行为数据加权结合，以改善公众意见和选举预测；其新意在于用历史数据校准LLM输出，并在多国调查和2024年美国大选中验证有效性。
cards.limitations: 证据基于特定调查数据（世界价值观调查、美国国家选举研究、德国选举调查）和2024年美国大选单一案例；未一致超越历史数据基准，泛化能力需更多任务和地区验证；德国多党应用仅为补充性展示。
cards.summaryEn: The study proposes Matching-LLM, a weighted framework that integrates LLM responses with historical human behavioral data to reconstruct survey responses and predict election outcomes. Results show it generally improves accuracy over LLM-only, including 11 of 12 comparisons on survey questions excluded from calibration, though it does not consistently outperform History-only. In the 2024 U.S. presidential election, Matching-LLM predicts 310 Republican electoral votes versus the actual 312, outperforming both single-source benchmarks; the authors conclude historical data can improve LLM-based predictions but task-specific validation is essential.
keyPointsEn: Matching-LLM outperforms LLM-only in 11 of 12 survey questions excluded from calibration.
It does not consistently beat the History-only benchmark, indicating historical data itself contributes substantially.
For the 2024 U.S. election, it predicts 310 Republican electoral votes versus the actual 312, outperforming both single-source benchmarks.
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces Matching-LLM, a weighted framework combining LLM-generated responses with historical human behavioral data to improve public opinion and election predictions; its novelty lies in calibrating LLM outputs with historical data and validating across multinational surveys and the 2024 U.S. election.
cards.originalTitle: Matching-LLM: Historically Anchored Synthetic Prediction of Public Opinion and Elections
cards.titleEn: Historically Anchored LLM Improves Public Opinion and Election Prediction Accuracy
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on specific survey data (World Values Survey, American National Election Studies, German election survey) and a single 2024 U.S. election case; it does not consistently outperform the history-only benchmark, so generalizability requires validation across more tasks and regions; the German multiparty application is only a supplementary demonstration.
keyPoints: Matching-LLM在12个未参与校准的调查问题中有11个优于纯LLM方法。
该方法未一致超越仅使用历史数据的基准，显示历史信息本身贡献显著。
2024年美国大选预测共和党获310张选举人票，实际为312张，优于两个单源基准。
cards.summary: 研究提出Matching-LLM加权框架，融合LLM回答与历史人类行为数据，用于重建调查回答和预测选举结果。实验显示，该方法在多数未参与校准的调查问题上优于纯LLM，但未稳定超越纯历史数据方法；在2024年美国大选中预测共和党获310张选举人票，接近实际312张。作者认为历史数据有潜力改善LLM预测，但强调需按任务验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a calibration approach that combines historical data with LLMs for public opinion and election forecasting, helping identify biases in LLM synthetic responses and highlighting the need for task-specific validation.
cards.title: 历史数据锚定LLM提升民调与选举预测精度
cards.whyItMatters: 为利用LLM进行民意和选举预测提供了一种结合历史数据的校准思路，有助于识别LLM合成回答的偏差，并强调任务特定验证的必要性。

cards.description: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 日榜出现，提出将代理会话中的行为压缩并注入后续会话，以缓解上下文丢失问题，对多代理工具链有实用价值。
cards.limitations: 输入仅包含项目自述，没有压缩质量、注入准确性、兼容稳定性或隐私影响的量化证据；是否在所列代理中均可用、是否存在数据留存风险，均需独立验证。
cards.summaryEn: claude-mem claims to capture everything an agent does during sessions, compress it with AI, and inject relevant context into future sessions. The source says it works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, and other agents. These capabilities come from the project's self-description, without independent verification or concrete effectiveness data.
keyPointsEn: The project aims to provide persistent cross-session context for every agent.
Its mechanism includes capturing session behavior, AI-based compression, and injecting relevant content into future sessions.
It claims support for Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode, and more.
cards.descriptionEn: The project appeared on GitHub Trending Daily, proposing to compress agent session behavior and inject relevant context into later sessions to mitigate context loss, with practical value for multi-agent toolchains.
cards.titleEn: claude-mem Brings Persistent Context to AI Agents Across Sessions
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only the project's self-description; there is no quantitative evidence on compression quality, injection accuracy, compatibility stability, or privacy impact. Whether it works across all listed agents and whether data retention risks exist require independent verification.
keyPoints: 项目目标是为每个代理提供跨会话的持久上下文。
机制包括捕获会话行为、AI 压缩和向未来会话注入相关内容。
声称支持 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等代理。
cards.summary: claude-mem 宣称能捕获代理会话中的所有行为、用 AI 压缩，并在未来会话中注入相关上下文。来源称其兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Copilot 等多种代理。这些能力来自项目自述，尚未提供独立验证或具体效果数据。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Cross-session context loss is a common friction in agent workflows; if effective, this approach could reduce repeated prompting and manual backtracking, improving continuity in multi-tool agent collaboration.
cards.title: claude-mem 为 AI 代理提供跨会话持久上下文
cards.whyItMatters: 跨会话上下文丢失是代理工作流中的常见摩擦，若该方案有效，可减少重复提示和人工回溯，提升多工具代理协作的连续性。

cards.description: 该项目在 GitHub 趋势榜出现，其主张是让每个 AI 同事拥有独立电脑环境（浏览器、文件与工具），并在动作执行前完成决策、执行后留下记录，同时支持接入任意 AG-UI 代理。新意在于把“可审计的先决策后执行”与“独立运行环境”结合为开源形态，对需要可追溯自动化流程的开发者有参考价值。
cards.limitations: 输入仅提供 GitHub 趋势榜的项目简介，未包含代码细节、实测效果、安全机制评估或与其他方案的对比，因此不能据此判断其可靠性、成熟度与适用范围。
cards.summaryEn: OpenBot is described as a set of open-source AI coworkers, each with its own computer including a browser, files and tools. It emphasizes deciding before acting and recording afterward, and claims support for any AG-UI agent. These are the project's self-described positions; actual capabilities require checking the code and documentation.
keyPointsEn: Positioned as open-source AI coworkers, each with a dedicated browser, files and tools environment
Workflow designed to decide before execution and record actions afterward
Claims compatibility with any AG-UI agent
cards.descriptionEn: The project appears on GitHub Trending and claims each AI coworker gets a dedicated computer with a browser, files and tools, decides actions before they happen and records them afterward, while accepting any AG-UI agent. Its novelty lies in combining an auditable decision-first workflow with isolated runtime environments in open-source form, which is relevant to developers needing traceable automation.
cards.titleEn: OpenBot: Open-Source AI Coworkers with Their Own Computers and Decision-First Execution
cards.limitationsEn: The input only provides a GitHub Trending project blurb, without code details, measured results, security evaluation, or comparison with alternatives, so its reliability, maturity and applicability cannot be judged from this alone.
keyPoints: 定位为开源 AI 同事，每个实例配独立浏览器、文件与工具环境
流程设计为先决策后执行，并在执行后记录动作
声称可接入任意 AG-UI 代理，强调兼容性
cards.summary: OpenBot 被描述为一组开源 AI 同事，每个都拥有自己的电脑，包括浏览器、文件与工具。其流程强调动作发生前先做决策、发生后进行记录，并可接入任意 AG-UI 代理。以上为项目自述定位，实际能力与效果需以代码和文档为准。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For teams building automation agents, isolated runtime environments plus pre- and post-execution records can help make agent behavior observable and reviewable; the open-source form also allows customization.
cards.title: OpenBot 开源 AI 同事：独立电脑与先决策后执行
cards.whyItMatters: 对构建自动化代理的团队而言，独立运行环境加执行前后留痕的设计，有助于把代理行为纳入可观察、可复核的流程；开源形态也便于按自身需求改造。

cards.description: 该工作提出 DocSkill 智能体框架，用学习到的技能编排策略在多页、多语言文档中自适应选择、回访或跳过证据获取技能；同时发布 6 万问答对、覆盖 10 种语言与 8 类文档域的 MMHop-DocBench 基准，为跨页证据追踪提供页级与元素级标注。
cards.limitations: 数据与结论均来自论文自身描述：MMHop-DocBench 由作者构建，HopGen 自动生成的证据路径与问答质量需独立核验；评测依赖所选用模型与基线集合，41.0 准确率与 49.2 F1 不宜外推到其他文档分布；MCTS 离线轨迹搜索与偏好数据构建的计算成本未在摘要中说明。
cards.summaryEn: The source notes that multilingual multi-hop document QA requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, pages, and languages, and that single-pass processing and adaptive tool use struggle to coordinate evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification. DocSkill uses bounded Monte Carlo Tree Search offline to explore skill trajectories, yielding demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning and preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization. Experiments report that DocSkill with Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 41.0 accuracy and 49.2 F1 on MMHop-DocBench and is competitive on MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench.
keyPointsEn: DocSkill's policy chooses, revisits, or skips skills based on the evolving evidence state rather than a fixed pipeline.
Bounded MCTS explores skill trajectories offline, providing SFT demonstrations and DPO preference pairs.
MMHop-DocBench contains 60K QA pairs across 10 languages and eight document domains with page- and element-level evidence annotations.
cards.descriptionEn: The work presents DocSkill, an agentic framework whose learned skill-orchestration policy adaptively selects, revisits, or skips evidence-acquisition skills across multi-page, multilingual documents while tracking evolving evidence state; it also releases MMHop-DocBench, a 60K QA-pair benchmark spanning 10 languages and eight document domains with page- and element-level evidence annotations.
cards.originalTitle: DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering
cards.titleEn: DocSkill: Learned Skill Orchestration for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document QA
cards.limitationsEn: All data and findings come from the paper's own account: MMHop-DocBench is author-built, and the quality of automatically generated evidence paths and QA pairs needs independent verification; evaluation depends on the chosen model and baseline set, so 41.0 accuracy and 49.2 F1 should not be extrapolated to other document distributions; computational costs of offline MCTS trajectory search and preference-data construction are not described in the abstract.
keyPoints: DocSkill 的技能编排策略依据动态证据状态选择、回访或跳过技能，而非固定流程。
用有界 MCTS 离线探索技能轨迹，为 SFT 提供示范、为 DPO 提供偏好对。
MMHop-DocBench 含 6 万问答对、10 种语言、8 类文档域，并提供页级与元素级证据标注。
cards.summary: 原文指出多语言多跳文档问答需跨复杂版式、页面和语言定位并整合证据，现有单次处理与自适应工具使用难以协调证据获取、跨页整合与答案验证。作者提出 DocSkill，用离线有界蒙特卡洛树搜索探索技能轨迹，生成监督微调示范与偏好对供直接偏好优化训练编排策略。实验报告 DocSkill 配合 Qwen3-VL-8B 在自建 MMHop-DocBench 上取得 41.0 准确率与 49.2 F1，并在 MMLongBench-Doc、DocBench 上表现有竞争力。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a framework linking learned skill scheduling with traceable cross-page evidence and a benchmark with fine-grained evidence annotations for multilingual multi-hop document QA, supporting comparison of orchestration and evidence-integration strategies; reported gains are limited to the evaluated setting.
cards.title: DocSkill：技能编排策略提升多语言多跳文档问答
cards.whyItMatters: 提供了一种将技能调度学习与可追溯跨页证据结合的方法框架，并给出带细粒度证据标注的多语言多跳文档问答基准，便于后续研究比较技能编排与证据整合策略；所述性能提升仅限论文所评估的设定。

cards.description: 提出一种与监督微调兼容的即插即用模块 AC-JEPA，在跨模态双向预测掩码中间状态，利用连续潜在目标容忍配对数据中的局部错误。在光学化学结构识别任务上，干净数据训练准确率达 76.07%，伪标签自训练后提升至 80.23%，均优于单独 SFT。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自光学化学结构识别这一测试床和 WildMol 基准的 Simple 集，未涵盖其他跨模态翻译任务或更复杂的数据条件。自训练实验仅使用一种伪标签生成方式，未系统评估伪标签噪声类型与程度的影响。与 SFT 的对比限于单一基线，未与其他半监督或自训练方法比较。
cards.summaryEn: AC-JEPA is an SFT-compatible plug-in that learns predictable cross-modal structure in a joint embedding space by predicting masked intermediate states in both directions, while retaining token-level SFT supervision. On optical chemical structure recognition, AC-JEPA reaches 76.07% accuracy with clean data versus 67.40% for SFT alone; with the same pseudo-labeled data for self-training, it rises to 80.23% while SFT drops to 63.47%. The authors view SFT-anchored joint-embedding prediction as an effective strategy for cross-modal translation under both curated and imperfect supervision.
keyPointsEn: AC-JEPA predicts masked intermediate states in both cross-modal directions; the joint-embedding objective targets cross-modal structure predictable from context, while the SFT path retains token-level supervision for the target sequence.

Self-training uses continuous latent targets derived from pseudo-labeled pairs, avoiding promotion of pseudo-tokens to hard categorical supervision and offering intrinsic tolerance to local data errors.

On the Simple set of the WildMol benchmark, AC-JEPA trained on clean pairs achieves 76.07% accuracy versus 67.40% for SFT; with the same pseudo-labeled data for self-training, AC-JEPA reaches 80.23% while SFT drops to 63.47%.
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces AC-JEPA, an SFT-compatible plug-in that predicts masked intermediate states in both cross-modal directions and uses continuous latent targets to tolerate local errors in paired data. On optical chemical structure recognition, it achieves 76.07% accuracy with clean training and 80.23% after pseudo-labeled self-training, outperforming SFT alone.
cards.originalTitle: AC-JEPA: Anchored Cross-Modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Visual-to-Symbolic Translation
cards.titleEn: AC-JEPA: Anchored Cross-Modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Visual-to-Symbolic Translation
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from optical chemical structure recognition on the Simple set of the WildMol benchmark, not from other cross-modal translation tasks or more complex data conditions. Self-training experiments use a single pseudo-label generation method and do not systematically evaluate the impact of pseudo-label noise types or levels. The comparison with SFT is limited to a single baseline and does not include other semi-supervised or self-training methods.
keyPoints: AC-JEPA 在跨模态双向预测掩码中间状态，联合嵌入目标关注可从上下文预测的跨模态结构，SFT 路径保留目标序列的 token 级监督。
自训练中使用从伪标签对导出的连续潜在目标，避免将伪 token 提升为硬分类监督，从而对局部数据错误有内在容忍。
在 WildMol 基准 Simple 集上，干净数据训练时 AC-JEPA 达 76.07% 准确率，SFT 为 67.40%；相同伪标签自训练下 AC-JEPA 达 80.23%，SFT 降至 63.47%。
cards.summary: AC-JEPA 是一种与 SFT 兼容的即插即用模块，通过跨模态双向预测掩码中间状态，在联合嵌入空间学习可预测的跨模态结构，同时保留 SFT 的 token 级监督。在光学化学结构识别测试中，干净数据下 AC-JEPA 准确率 76.07%，高于 SFT 的 67.40%；使用相同伪标签自训练时，AC-JEPA 升至 80.23%，而 SFT 降至 63.47%。作者认为，SFT 锚定的联合嵌入预测是应对精选与不完美监督下跨模态翻译的有效策略。
cards.whyItMattersEn: In real scientific domains, paired data are often imperfect and clean pairs are costly at scale. AC-JEPA offers a way to self-train in a joint embedding space with continuous latent targets, maintaining or improving performance when pseudo-labels contain local errors, providing a viable optimization direction for cross-modal translation under imperfect supervision.
cards.title: AC-JEPA：提升视觉到符号翻译的跨模态联合嵌入预测
cards.whyItMatters: 在真实科学领域，配对数据常不完美且获取干净配对成本高。AC-JEPA 提供了一种在联合嵌入空间利用连续潜在目标进行自训练的途径，能在伪标签存在局部错误时保持甚至提升性能，为跨模态翻译任务在 imperfect supervision 下提供了可行的优化方向。

cards.description: 该研究首次对ICT的积累-操纵-分配（AMD）模型在CME E-Mini纳斯达克100期货上进行系统量化评估，将模型规则转化为严格机械策略，并检验其信号的统计特性。其新意在于用真实高频数据揭示模型时机假设与实际价格交付的结构性错配，并发现信号仅在与日趋势一致时具有方向性信息。
cards.limitations: 该研究仅针对CME E-Mini纳斯达克100期货的特定操作化实现，结论不能推广至其他资产或参数设定；样本期为2022年1月至2026年7月，覆盖的市场状态有限；作者明确表示状态依赖信号模式是待后续研究验证的假设，而非因果结论；此外，研究未考虑交易成本、滑点及执行延迟对策略净收益的影响，因此结果不构成投资建议。
cards.summaryEn: The author operationalizes the AMD model into a mechanical strategy and analyzes 484 manipulation signal days using chi-square testing, Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and regime-conditional analysis on 15-minute OHLCV data from January 2022 to July 2026. Key findings: the manipulation signal fires on 44% of trading days; 57% of valid signals see full target delivery before the 9:40 AM New York entry window; and the signal performs well only when aligned with the daily trend (62-71% correct) versus 25-30% when opposed. The author frames these findings as a testable hypothesis rather than a final verdict on the model's validity.
keyPointsEn: The AMD manipulation signal fires on 44% of trading days, but 57% of valid signals complete target delivery before the New York entry window, indicating a structural mismatch between the model's timing assumptions and actual price paths.
Directional information is highly regime-dependent: when aligned with the daily trend, accuracy is 62-71% (Cohen's h = 0.23-0.43); when opposed, only 25-30% (Cohen's h = 0.42-0.53).

All four trending-regime cells survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and key findings are robust to variations in the manipulation breach threshold (5-20 NQ points), Asia range filter percentile, and stop buffer.
cards.descriptionEn: This study provides the first systematic quantitative evaluation of ICT's Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution (AMD) model on CME E-Mini Nasdaq-100 futures, operationalizing the model into a strict mechanical strategy and testing its signal's statistical properties. Its novelty lies in using real high-frequency data to reveal a structural mismatch between the model's timing assumptions and actual price delivery, and in finding that the signal carries directional information
cards.originalTitle: Evaluating the Predictive Validity of ICT's Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution (AMD) Model on CME E-Mini NASDAQ-100 Futures
cards.titleEn: Predictive Validity of ICT's AMD Model on Nasdaq-100 Futures
cards.limitationsEn: The study is limited to a specific operationalization on CME E-Mini Nasdaq-100 futures, and conclusions cannot be generalized to other assets or parameter settings; the sample period from January 2022 to July 2026 covers a limited set of market conditions; the author explicitly frames the regime-dependent signal pattern as a hypothesis for follow-on research rather than a causal conclusion; moreover, transaction costs, slippage, and execution delays are not considered, so the results do not constitute investment advice.
keyPoints: AMD操纵信号在44%的交易日触发，但57%的有效信号在纽约入场窗口前已完成目标交付，显示模型时机假设与实际价格路径存在结构性错配。
信号方向性信息高度依赖日趋势状态：与趋势一致时正确率62-71%（Cohen's h=0.23-0.43），反向时仅25-30%（Cohen's h=0.42-0.53）。
四个趋势状态单元格均通过Benjamini-Hochberg多重比较校正，且主要发现对操纵突破阈值（5-20 NQ点）、亚洲区间过滤百分位和止损缓冲的变化保持稳健。
cards.summary: 作者将AMD模型操作化为机械策略，基于2022年1月至2026年7月的15分钟OHLCV数据，对484个操纵信号日进行卡方检验、Benjamini-Hochberg多重比较校正和状态条件分析。主要发现：操纵信号在44%的交易日触发；57%的有效信号在纽约入场窗口（9:40 AM）前已完成目标交付；信号仅在与日趋势一致时表现较好（正确率62-71%），反向时仅25-30%。作者认为这些发现构成一个可检验的假设，而非对模型有效性的最终结论。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study provides the first quantitative testing framework for ICT's AMD model using real futures data, revealing structural issues between the model's timing assumptions and actual price delivery, and proposing a regime-dependent testable hypothesis. For quantitative researchers, this implies that mechanically applying AMD rules may be ineffective without conditioning on trend regime; the study also demonstrates how to translate narrative trading theories into falsifiable statistical hypotheses.
cards.title: ICT的AMD模型在纳斯达克100期货上的预测效度检验
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为ICT的AMD模型提供了首个基于真实期货数据的量化检验框架，揭示了模型时机假设与实际价格交付之间的结构性问题，并提出了状态依赖的可检验假设。对于量化研究者而言，这意味着直接机械套用AMD规则可能无效，而需结合趋势状态进行条件化建模；同时，该研究示范了如何将叙述性交易理论转化为可证伪的统计假设。

cards.description: 提出一个模型无关的框架，在推理时向因果LLM注入SEC 10-K公司知识图谱信息，以增强金融新闻情绪分析的上下文并提升可解释性。
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者模拟，未涉及真实交易部署或跨市场稳健性；知识图谱仅基于SEC 10-K，可能遗漏其他公司信息；性能提升幅度与统计显著性未在摘要中量化；依赖检索质量与知识图谱覆盖。
cards.summaryEn: Existing financial sentiment LLMs often predict each article in isolation as black boxes, limiting contextual understanding and deployment in high-stakes decisions. The authors propose FinLLM-KG, which injects company-level knowledge from a financial knowledge graph at inference time as a natural-language profile or a few ranked factual triples, without updating model weights. Simulations show consistent portfolio performance improvement over a state-of-the-art baseline, with sentence- and fact-level attribution.
keyPointsEn: FinLLM-KG retrieves company-level facts from a financial knowledge graph built on SEC 10-K filings and injects them into causal LLMs at inference as a natural-language profile or ranked triples, without fine-tuning.
The framework attributes each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and retrieved knowledge-graph facts, enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review.
In simulations, FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline.
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces a model-agnostic framework that injects SEC 10-K company knowledge from a financial knowledge graph into causal LLMs at inference time to enhance context and explainability in financial news sentiment analysis.
cards.originalTitle: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
cards.titleEn: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from author simulations; no real trading deployment or cross-market robustness is shown. The knowledge graph relies only on SEC 10-K filings and may miss other company information. The magnitude and statistical significance of performance gains are not quantified in the abstract. Performance depends on retrieval quality and knowledge-graph coverage.
keyPoints: FinLLM-KG在推理时从SEC 10-K构建的金融知识图谱中检索公司级事实，以自然语言简介或排序三元组形式注入因果LLM，无需微调。
框架将文章级情绪得分归因到具体句子和检索到的知识图谱事实，增强可解释性并支持人工复核。
模拟实验中，FinLLM-KG在投资组合表现上持续优于最先进基线。
cards.summary: 现有金融情绪分析LLM多孤立预测单篇文章且为黑箱，限制上下文理解与高风险决策部署。作者提出FinLLM-KG，在推理时以自然语言公司简介或少量排序事实三元组注入公司级知识，无需更新模型权重。模拟显示其投资组合表现持续优于最先进基线，并支持句子级与知识事实级归因。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The approach lets sentiment predictions account for firm-level context rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM; the inspectable evidence chain supports human-machine collaboration in high-stakes financial decisions.
cards.title: FinLLM-KG：知识图谱增强LLM的金融情绪分析框架
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法让情绪预测纳入公司层面背景信息而非仅依赖单篇文章，且几乎不增加计算成本，适用于任意因果LLM；可检查的证据链有助于高风险金融决策中的人机协作。

cards.description: 该工作提出 Investor's Last Exam（ILE）基准，用带版本与时间戳的金融数据库和专家评分框架，在严格冻结的信息集下评估 AI 智能体的完整股票研究流程。其新意在于把评估单位从孤立能力转向“证据—假设—判断”链条，并同时衡量研究质量、预测准确性与模拟投资表现；对需要定位智能体分析优势为何未转化为预测与投资判断的研究者和开发者具有诊断价值。
cards.limitations: 证据边界需注意：这些结论基于论文自建的 ILE 基准和 86 项评估任务，作者未说明其覆盖的市场、时期与资产范围能否代表更广泛的股票投资场景。模型得分反映的是该冻结信息集与专家评分框架下的表现，不能直接外推为真实投资能力或收益。总分与“预测与模型”分数的对比是作者对“研究能力未转化为预测表现”的解读，属于基于有限基准的推断。基准由专家主导设计，评分依赖其标准与依赖图，潜在的设计与评分偏差未在输入中给出量化评估。
cards.summaryEn: The paper builds ILE, an equity-research benchmark with a versioned financial database spanning 3.43 million document versions across nine source categories plus structured market data; retrieval and computation are governed by validated timestamps. Tasks are organized around professional analyst deliverables, and an expert-led framework links scoring criteria to sources, calculations, and assumptions via financial dependency graphs, with evaluation spanning 86 assignments. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead overall at 68.1 and 66.9 out of 100, yet even Astra scores only 52.5 on Forecast & Model; the authors conclude that even state-of-the-art models fail to translate overall research capability into predictive performance.
keyPointsEn: ILE uses a versioned financial database (3.43 million document versions across nine source categories) plus structured market data, with validated timestamps governing retrieval and computation to form a strictly frozen information set.

The task taxonomy is organized around professional analyst deliverables, and an expert-led framework links scoring criteria to sources, calculations, and assumptions via financial dependency graphs, with evaluation spanning 86 assignments.
Evaluation jointly assesses research quality, forecast accuracy, and simulated investment performance; GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead overall, but Astra scores only 52.5 on Forecast & Model.
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces Investor's Last Exam (ILE), a benchmark that evaluates AI agents across the full equity-research process using a versioned, timestamp-governed financial database and an expert-led scoring framework under a strictly frozen information set. Its novelty lies in shifting the unit of evaluation from isolated capabilities to the evidence–assumption–judgment chain and in jointly measuring research quality, forecast accuracy, and simulated investment performance,
cards.originalTitle: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
cards.titleEn: Investor's Last Exam: Evaluating AI Agents on Equity Research Under a Frozen Information Set
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries: the findings rest on the paper's own ILE benchmark and 86 evaluation assignments, and the input does not establish whether its market, period, and asset coverage represents broader equity-investment settings. Scores reflect performance under this frozen information set and expert scoring framework and cannot be directly extrapolated to real investment capability or returns. The contrast between overall and Forecast & Model scores is the authors' interpretation that research capability fails to translate into predictive performance, an inference from a limited benchmark. The benchmark is expert-led, and the input provides no quantitative assessment of potential design or scoring bias.
keyPoints: ILE 使用版本化金融数据库（覆盖 343 万份文档版本、9 类来源）和结构化市场数据，并以有效时间戳约束检索与计算，形成严格冻结的信息集。
任务分类围绕专业分析师交付物设计，专家主导的评分框架通过金融依赖图把评分标准与来源、计算和假设相连，评估共覆盖 86 项任务。
评估同时考察研究质量、预测准确性和模拟投资表现；GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5 总分领先，但 Astra 在“预测与模型”一项仅 52.5 分。
cards.summary: 论文构建了面向股票研究的 ILE 基准，包含覆盖 343 万份文档版本、9 类来源并带有效时间戳的版本化金融数据库，外加结构化市场数据，检索与计算均受时间戳约束。任务按专业分析师的交付物组织，并由专家主导的框架借助金融依赖图把评分标准与来源、计算和假设关联起来，评估覆盖 86 项任务。结果显示 GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5 总分领先（68.1 与 66.9，满分 100），但即使 Astra 在“预测与模型”一项也仅得 52.5。作者据此认为，即使最先进模型也未能把整体研究能力转化为预测表现。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark shifts evaluation from isolated capabilities to the full evidence–assumption–judgment chain, helping researchers locate where analytical advantages fail to translate into forecasts and investment judgments and providing a traceable, diagnostic foundation for training and evaluating financial agents.
cards.title: 投资者终考基准：AI智能体在冻结信息下的股票研究评估
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准把评估焦点从单项能力转向完整的证据—假设—判断链条，有助于研究者定位分析优势在何处未能转化为预测和投资判断，并为训练与评估金融智能体提供可追溯、可诊断的基础。

cards.description: 现有智能编辑系统多采用多阶段流水线，紧凑任务专用策略的质量-成本权衡尚不明确。WeVisCut 将工具执行与策略学习结合，用单一9B策略完成长视频制作，在共享工具环境下以远少于基线的生成 token 达到与 Claude Opus 5 相当的性能。
cards.limitations: 性能优势基于作者提出的 100 任务基准和五个自定义指标，尚未在更广泛或第三方基准上验证；token 效率对比限于共享工具环境与特定成功输出定义；数据管道依赖成品视频的编辑反转与验证回放，其恢复意图的覆盖与保真度未独立评估；未报告与 Claude Opus 5 对比的统计显著性。
cards.summaryEn: WeVisCut is a long-form script-to-video system whose agent harness maintains shared production state so tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. A four-stage data pipeline combining editing inversion with verified replay recovers editing intent from 3,750 finished videos, yielding over 130K training examples used to train a single 9B policy. The authors report that this policy substantially outperforms its base model on a 100-task benchmark and achieves performance comparable to Claude Opus 5 while using nearly 33x fewer generated tokens per successful output minute.
keyPointsEn: Introduces an agent harness with shared production state that lets editing tool feedback drive subsequent decisions and failure repairs.
A four-stage data pipeline inverts editing intent from finished videos and, via verified replay, produces over 130K executable supervision examples.
A single 9B policy substantially outperforms its base model in a shared tool environment, approaching Claude Opus 5 with nearly 33x better token efficiency.
cards.descriptionEn: Existing agentic editors often rely on multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact task-adapted policies unclear. WeVisCut connects tool execution with policy learning, using a single 9B policy for long-form video production and achieving performance comparable to Claude Opus 5 with far fewer generated tokens in a shared tool environment.
cards.originalTitle: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
cards.titleEn: WeVisCut: A Single Agent for End-to-End Narration-to-Long-Form Video Editing
cards.limitationsEn: Performance advantages are measured on the authors' 100-task benchmark and five custom metrics, without validation on broader or third-party benchmarks; token efficiency comparison is limited to the shared tool environment and a specific definition of successful output; the data pipeline relies on editing inversion and verified replay from finished videos, whose coverage and fidelity in recovering intent are not independently assessed; statistical significance versus Claude Opus 5 is not reported.
keyPoints: 提出共享制作状态的智能体框架，使编辑工具反馈驱动后续决策与故障修复。
四阶段数据管道从成品视频反转编辑意图，经验证回放生成超 13 万可执行监督样本。
单一 9B 策略在共享工具环境下显著优于基模型，性能接近 Claude Opus 5 且 token 效率高近 33 倍。
cards.summary: WeVisCut 是一个长视频脚本到视频系统，其智能体框架维护共享制作状态，使工具反馈能影响后续决策与修复。作者通过四阶段数据管道（结合编辑反转与验证回放）从 3,750 个成品视频中恢复编辑意图，生成超过 13 万训练样本，并据此训练单一 9B 策略。作者报告该策略在 100 任务基准上显著优于基模型，性能与 Claude Opus 5 相当且每成功输出分钟生成 token 少近 33 倍。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work suggests that compact task-adapted policies can match general large models in long-form video editing quality while greatly reducing generated token consumption, offering a reproducible path for supervision construction and evaluation in cost-sensitive automated video production.
cards.title: WeVisCut：单智能体实现解说词到长视频的全流程编辑
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作表明，紧凑的任务专用策略可在长视频编辑中实现与通用大模型相当的质量，同时大幅降低生成 token 消耗，为成本敏感的长视频自动化制作提供了可复现的监督构建与评估路径。

cards.description: 该仓库提供开源 Grok Bot 替代实现，核心差异是让机器人可调用一台虚拟机执行任务；它把执行环境纳入开源形态，便于开发者自行部署与验证。
cards.limitations: 输入仅包含 GitHub Trending 的一句话简介与仓库名，无文档、代码结构、许可证、版本发布、基准测试或安全隔离说明。因此无法判断实际可用性、虚拟机的隔离强度、支持的任务类型，以及与 Grok Bot 的功能差异程度；不宜据此推断项目成熟度或生产适用性。
cards.summaryEn: GitHub Trending lists milind-soni/OpenMausBot, described as an open-source Grok Bot alternative that includes a virtual machine for bots. The input provides no concrete features, implementation approach, or performance data, so only the project positioning and execution-environment trait are confirmed. Claims of alternative value are author framing rather than verified facts.
keyPointsEn: The project describes itself as an open-source Grok Bot alternative.
Its notable trait is providing a virtual machine bots can use as an execution environment.
Only a Trending blurb is available, lacking implementation details and benchmark data.
cards.descriptionEn: The repository offers an open-source Grok Bot alternative whose distinguishing feature is a virtual machine that bots can use to execute tasks; it brings the execution environment into an open form for developers to deploy and inspect themselves.
cards.titleEn: Open-source Grok bot alternative with a bot-usable virtual machine
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only a one-line GitHub Trending blurb and repository name, with no documentation, code structure, license, release history, benchmarks, or security-isolation details. Therefore actual usability, VM isolation strength, supported task types, and the extent of functional difference from Grok Bot cannot be judged; the project's maturity or production suitability should not be inferred.
keyPoints: 项目自述为开源 Grok Bot 替代方案。
特点是为机器人提供一台可用的虚拟机作为执行环境。
目前仅有 Trending 简介信息，缺少实现细节与评测数据。
cards.summary: GitHub Trending 收录了 milind-soni/OpenMausBot，简介称其为开源 Grok Bot 替代方案，并配备可供机器人使用的虚拟机。输入未给出具体功能、实现方式或性能数据，因此这里只确认项目定位与执行环境特点。作者观点（如替代价值）与事实性描述应分开看待。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Combining a bot execution environment (a virtual machine) with an open-source approach lets developers deploy, inspect, and extend task execution chains themselves instead of relying on closed services; it is also a reference point for studying the boundaries of bot-system deployment.
cards.title: 开源Grok机器人替代方案：为机器人提供可用虚拟机
cards.whyItMatters: 将机器人执行环境（虚拟机）与开源方案结合，有助于开发者自主部署、检查与扩展任务执行链路，而不必依赖封闭服务；对研究机器人系统落地边界也有参考价值。

cards.description: 通过对比两种交易策略（A：风险1盈利1、胜率60%；B：风险1盈利3、胜率30%），展示二者每笔交易的期望收益相同（+0.20美元），但连续亏损的概率差异显著，提示交易者需关注策略的心理可执行性。
cards.limitations: 内容基于固定胜率与风险回报比的简化计算，未考虑交易成本、滑点、市场环境变化及策略参数估计误差；概率结果假设每笔交易独立同分布，实际市场可能存在序列相关或非平稳性。
cards.summaryEn: The source uses numerical examples to illustrate that different combinations of win rate and risk-reward ratio can yield the same edge per trade. The author's view emphasizes that the same mathematical edge does not mean the same trading experience; the high-volatility path may affect execution.
keyPointsEn: Strategy A (60% win rate, 1:1 risk-reward) and Strategy B (30% win rate, 1:3 risk-reward) both have an expected profit of +$0.20 per trade.
Over 100 trades, Strategy B has about a 58% chance of experiencing 10 or more consecutive losses, while for Strategy A it is under 1%.
Under the same expected return, Strategy B has greater equity curve volatility and demands higher psychological tolerance from the trader.
cards.descriptionEn: Using two strategies (A: risk $1 to make $1, 60% win rate; B: risk $1 to make $3, 30% win rate), the source shows both have the same expected edge per trade (+$0.20) but differ significantly in the probability of consecutive losses, highlighting the need to consider psychological executability.
cards.originalTitle: What quant traders actually do all day #quanttrading #algotrading #quantfinance
cards.titleEn: Quant Trading Daily: Balancing Risk-Reward and Win Rate
cards.limitationsEn: The content is based on simplified calculations with fixed win rates and risk-reward ratios, ignoring transaction costs, slippage, changing market conditions, and parameter estimation errors. Probability results assume independent and identically distributed trades, whereas actual markets may exhibit serial correlation or non-stationarity.
keyPoints: 策略A（胜率60%，风险回报比1:1）与策略B（胜率30%，风险回报比1:3）每笔交易期望收益均为+0.20美元。
在100笔交易中，策略B连续亏损10笔及以上的概率约为58%，策略A则低于1%。
相同的期望收益下，策略B的资金曲线波动更大，对交易者心理承受力要求更高。
cards.summary: 来源内容以具体数值示例说明：胜率与风险回报比的组合可产生相同的每笔交易优势。作者观点强调，相同的数学优势不代表相同的交易体验，高波动路径可能影响执行。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This comparison reminds quantitative traders to consider the probability of consecutive losses and its impact on execution discipline and money management, beyond expected return, to avoid deviating from the strategy due to psychological pressure.
cards.title: 量化交易日常：风险回报与胜率的权衡
cards.whyItMatters: 该对比提醒量化交易者在评估策略时，除了期望收益，还需考虑连续亏损概率对执行纪律和资金管理的影响，避免因心理压力偏离策略。
